scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test:worker: npm run types && vite build && vitest run
scripts.build: npm run types && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.check: npm run types && tsc -b --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node scripts/require-public-site-url.mjs && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
